_note: Sperm-optimization score. Sub-factors are 0-100. Overall = weighted sum. Computed fresh every dashboard render (i.e. daily) from a trailing 7-day window ending on the render date — the 7-day span itself is intentional (sperm parameters reflect ~weeks of buildup, not a single day), but the number now updates daily as that window rolls forward, not on a fixed weekly cadence.

model._weights_note: ejaculatory_frequency added 2026-07-11 at 10% weight; the other six factors were scaled down proportionally (x0.9) from their original values so all weights still sum to 1.0.
